#!/bin/sh
set -eu
GOAT_NODE_SCRIPT_PATH=''
# Older clients inspect these literal declarations without evaluating the runner.
T3_NODE_SCRIPT_PATH=''
GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION='1.2.3-preview.20260911.4'
T3_ARCHIVE_VERSION='1.2.3-preview.20260911.4'
# End of the declarations GOAT reads without running this runner.
goat_runtime_fs() (
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    MINGW* | MSYS* | CYGWIN*) ;;
    *) "$@"; exit $? ;;
  esac
  # mv nests a stage in an existing directory; GNU -T renames onto an empty one, refuses the rest.
  if [ "$1" = mv ]; then set -- mv -T "$2" "$3"; fi
  for delay in 0 1 2 4 8 10 10 10; do
    [ "$delay" = 0 ] || sleep "$delay"
    if [ "$2" = -T ] && { [ -e "$4" ] || [ -L "$4" ]; }; then
      printf 'Cannot publish %s: %s already exists.\n' "$3" "$4" >&2; exit 1
    fi
    if output="$(LC_ALL=C "$@" 2>&1)"; then
      [ -z "$output" ] || printf '%s\n' "$output"
      exit 0
    else
      status=$?
    fi
    case "$output" in
      *'Permission denied'* | *'Device or resource busy'* | *'Access is denied'*) ;;
      *) printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; exit "$status" ;;
    esac
  done
  printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
  printf '%s\n' 'An antivirus/real-time scan may be locking the new goat.exe. Consider excluding %USERPROFILE%\.goat\runtime, then retry.' >&2
  exit "$status"
)
goat_runtime_publish() {
  # Another installer may have completed this version during extraction on Windows; keep it.
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    MINGW* | MSYS* | CYGWIN*)
      if [ -x "$2/goat" ] && [ "$(cat "$2/.install-complete" 2>/dev/null)" = "$3" ]; then
        rm -rf "$1" 2>/dev/null || :; return 0
      fi ;;
  esac
  goat_runtime_fs rm -rf "$2"
  goat_runtime_fs mv "$1" "$2"
}
prepend_path_if_dir() {
  if [ -d "$1" ]; then
    case ":$PATH:" in
      *":$1:"*) ;;
      *) PATH="$1:$PATH" ;;
    esac
  fi
}

remote_node_satisfies_engine() {
  GOAT_NODE_ENGINE_RANGE=''
  if [ -z "$GOAT_NODE_ENGINE_RANGE" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  node - "$GOAT_NODE_ENGINE_RANGE" <<'NODE'
function satisfiesSemverRange(rawVersion, range) {
  const normalizedVersion = String(rawVersion).trim().replace(/^v/, "");
  const versionMatch = normalizedVersion.match(
    /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\.(\d+))?(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/,
  );
  if (!versionMatch) {
    return false;
  }

  const version = {
    major: Number(versionMatch[1]),
    minor: Number(versionMatch[2] || 0),
    patch: Number(versionMatch[3] || 0),
  };

  return range.split("||").some((group) => {
    const comparators = group.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (comparators.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }
    return comparators.every((comparator) => {
      const match = comparator.trim().match(/^(\^|>=|>|<=|<|=)?\s*v?(\d+(?:\.\d+){0,2})$/);
      if (!match) {
        return false;
      }
      const targetVersion = match[2];
      if (targetVersion === undefined) {
        return false;
      }
      const targetMatch = targetVersion.match(/^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\.(\d+))?$/);
      if (!targetMatch) {
        return false;
      }
      const target = {
        major: Number(targetMatch[1]),
        minor: Number(targetMatch[2] || 0),
        patch: Number(targetMatch[3] || 0),
      };
      const compared =
        version.major !== target.major
          ? version.major > target.major
            ? 1
            : -1
          : version.minor !== target.minor
            ? version.minor > target.minor
              ? 1
              : -1
            : version.patch !== target.patch
              ? version.patch > target.patch
                ? 1
                : -1
              : 0;
      const operator = match[1] || "=";
      switch (operator) {
        case "^":
          if (compared < 0) {
            return false;
          }
          if (target.major > 0) {
            return version.major === target.major;
          }
          if (target.minor > 0) {
            return version.major === 0 && version.minor === target.minor;
          }
          return version.major === 0 && version.minor === 0 && version.patch === target.patch;
        case ">=":
          return compared >= 0;
        case ">":
          return compared > 0;
        case "<=":
          return compared <= 0;
        case "<":
          return compared < 0;
        case "=":
          return compared === 0;
        default:
          return false;
      }
    });
  });
}
var range = process.argv[2] || "";
var rawVersion =
  process.versions && process.versions.node ? process.versions.node : process.version;
if (!satisfiesSemverRange(rawVersion, range)) {
  process.stderr.write(
    "Remote node " + rawVersion + " does not satisfy required range " + range + ".\n",
  );
  process.exit(1);
}
NODE
}

ensure_remote_node_path() {
  if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && remote_node_satisfies_engine >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    return 0
  fi

  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.local/bin"
  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/bin"
  prepend_path_if_dir "/opt/homebrew/bin"
  prepend_path_if_dir "/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin"
  prepend_path_if_dir "/usr/local/bin"
  prepend_path_if_dir "/usr/bin"
  prepend_path_if_dir "/bin"
  # lsof lives in sbin on macOS. A login PATH that already has node returns
  # before these lines, so the launch script also prepends them unconditionally.
  prepend_path_if_dir "/usr/sbin"
  prepend_path_if_dir "/sbin"

  if [ -z "${VOLTA_HOME:-}" ]; then
    VOLTA_HOME="$HOME/.volta"
  fi
  export VOLTA_HOME
  prepend_path_if_dir "$VOLTA_HOME/bin"

  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.asdf/shims"
  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.asdf/bin"
  if [ ! -x "$HOME/.asdf/shims/node" ] && [ -s "$HOME/.asdf/asdf.sh" ]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1090
    . "$HOME/.asdf/asdf.sh"
  fi

  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims"
  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.mise/shims"
  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    eval "$(mise activate sh)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi

  if [ -z "${FNM_DIR:-}" ]; then
    FNM_DIR="$HOME/.local/share/fnm"
  fi
  export FNM_DIR
  prepend_path_if_dir "$FNM_DIR"
  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.fnm"
  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v fnm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    eval "$(fnm env --shell bash)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fnm use --silent-if-unchanged >/dev/null 2>&1 || fnm use default >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi

  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.nodenv/bin"
  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.nodenv/shims"
  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v nodenv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    eval "$(nodenv init -)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi

  if [ -z "${NVM_DIR:-}" ]; then
    NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
  fi
  export NVM_DIR

  if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1090
    . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
    if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v nvm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      nvm use --silent default >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use --silent node >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use --silent --lts >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
  fi

  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d "$NVM_DIR/versions/node" ]; then
    for GOAT_NODE_BIN in "$NVM_DIR"/versions/node/*/bin; do
      if [ -x "$GOAT_NODE_BIN/node" ]; then
        PATH="$GOAT_NODE_BIN:$PATH"
        export PATH
      fi
    done
  fi

  command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && remote_node_satisfies_engine
}
if [ -n "$GOAT_NODE_SCRIPT_PATH" ]; then
  # Dev mode: a source checkout on the remote. This is the only path that
  # needs Node, so Node discovery runs here and nowhere else.
  ensure_remote_node_path || true
  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    printf 'Remote host is missing node on PATH. Install Node or configure a supported version manager for non-interactive shells.\n' >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  exec node "$GOAT_NODE_SCRIPT_PATH" "$@"
fi
if [ -z "$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION" ]; then
  printf 'No GOAT release version was provided for the remote runtime.\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi
# Self-contained release archive: no Node, npm, or compiler on the remote.
# Unpacked into the pinned-runtime layout so `goat service install` reuses it.
GOAT_RELEASE_BASE_URL='https://github.com/goat-si/goat-releases/releases/download'
GOAT_RUNTIME_DIR="$HOME/.goat/runtime/goat/versions/$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION"
goat_runtime_ready() {
  [ -x "$GOAT_RUNTIME_DIR/goat" ] && [ "$(cat "$GOAT_RUNTIME_DIR/.install-complete" 2>/dev/null)" = "$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION" ]
}
if ! goat_runtime_ready; then
  mkdir -p "$HOME/.goat/runtime/goat/versions"
  # Cleanup takes this mutex exclusively; installs may still run concurrently.
  if [ "$(uname -s)" = Linux ] && command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    GOAT_MAINTENANCE="$HOME/.goat/runtime/goat/versions/.maintenance.lock"
    [ ! -L "$GOAT_MAINTENANCE" ] || exit 1
    exec 9>"$GOAT_MAINTENANCE"
    flock -w 360 -s 9
  fi
  GOAT_LOCK="$HOME/.goat/runtime/goat/versions/.$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION.install.lock"
  # Publish a nonempty directory with an immutable pid and unique token by
  # same-filesystem rename. mv can nest it in an existing lock: only a token
  # at the lock root proves acquisition; losers clean their candidate and
  # retry. There is no mkdir-to-pid window at the shared lock path.
  # Reclaimers cd into the generation BEFORE reading its pid, and delete
  # only relative contents of that directory. The final rmdir cannot remove
  # a newer generation because every published lock is already nonempty.
  # A reclaim counts only once the lock is gone; a lock that cannot be
  # entered or emptied waits like a live one, so the timeout still applies.
  # Legacy pid-less locks retain their short grace period.
  GOAT_LOCK_CANDIDATE=""
  GOAT_LOCK_TOKEN=""
  GOAT_STAGING=""
  goat_remove_lock_contents() {
    find . ! -name . -prune -exec rm -rf {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
    rmdir "$GOAT_LOCK" 2>/dev/null || [ ! -e "$GOAT_LOCK" ]
  }
  goat_lock_cleanup() {
    (
      cd "$GOAT_LOCK" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
      [ -n "$GOAT_LOCK_TOKEN" ] && [ -f "./$GOAT_LOCK_TOKEN" ] || exit 0
      goat_remove_lock_contents || true
    ) || true
    if [ -n "$GOAT_LOCK_CANDIDATE" ]; then
      rm -rf "$GOAT_LOCK_CANDIDATE" "$GOAT_LOCK/${GOAT_LOCK_CANDIDATE##*/}"
    fi
    if [ -n "$GOAT_STAGING" ]; then goat_runtime_fs rm -rf "$GOAT_STAGING" || :; fi
  }
  trap 'goat_exit=$?; goat_lock_cleanup || true; exit "$goat_exit"' 0
  trap 'exit 1' 1 2 3 15
  goat_reclaim_lock() (
    if ! cd "$GOAT_LOCK" 2>/dev/null; then
      if [ -e "$GOAT_LOCK" ]; then exit 3; fi
      exit 0
    fi
    GOAT_LOCK_OWNER="$(cat pid 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ -n "$GOAT_LOCK_OWNER" ]; then
      if kill -0 "$GOAT_LOCK_OWNER" 2>/dev/null; then exit 2; fi
    elif [ "$GOAT_LOCK_UNOWNED" -lt 4 ]; then
      exit 1
    fi
    goat_remove_lock_contents || exit 3
  )
  GOAT_LOCK_WAITED=0
  GOAT_LOCK_UNOWNED=0
  while :; do
    GOAT_LOCK_CANDIDATE="$(mktemp -d "$GOAT_LOCK.candidate-$$-XXXXXX")"
    GOAT_LOCK_TOKEN="${GOAT_LOCK_CANDIDATE##*/}"
    if { printf '%s\n' "$$" > "$GOAT_LOCK_CANDIDATE/pid" &&
         : > "$GOAT_LOCK_CANDIDATE/$GOAT_LOCK_TOKEN"; } 2>/dev/null; then
      mv "$GOAT_LOCK_CANDIDATE" "$GOAT_LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true
      if [ -f "$GOAT_LOCK/$GOAT_LOCK_TOKEN" ]; then break; fi
    fi
    rm -rf "$GOAT_LOCK_CANDIDATE" "$GOAT_LOCK/$GOAT_LOCK_TOKEN"
    GOAT_LOCK_CANDIDATE=""
    if [ ! -e "$GOAT_LOCK" ]; then
      # Publication failed with no competing lock; wait so a persistent
      # failure reaches the timeout.
      :
    elif goat_reclaim_lock; then continue
    else
      GOAT_LOCK_STATUS=$?
      case "$GOAT_LOCK_STATUS" in
        1) GOAT_LOCK_UNOWNED=$((GOAT_LOCK_UNOWNED + 1)) ;;
        2) GOAT_LOCK_UNOWNED=0 ;;
      esac
    fi
    if [ "$GOAT_LOCK_WAITED" -ge 360 ]; then
      printf 'Another GOAT %s installation has held %s for too long.\n' "$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION" "$GOAT_LOCK" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    sleep 1
    GOAT_LOCK_WAITED=$((GOAT_LOCK_WAITED + 1))
  done
fi
if ! goat_runtime_ready; then
  # Keep aligned with CLI_ARCHIVE_PLATFORM_KEYS in packages/shared/src/cliRelease.ts.
  case "$(uname -s) $(uname -m)" in
    "Darwin arm64") GOAT_PLATFORM_KEY="darwin-arm64" ;;
    "Linux arm64" | "Linux aarch64") GOAT_PLATFORM_KEY="linux-arm64" ;;
    "Linux x86_64" | "Linux amd64") GOAT_PLATFORM_KEY="linux-x64" ;;
    MINGW*" arm64" | MSYS*" arm64" | CYGWIN*" arm64" | MINGW*" aarch64" | MSYS*" aarch64" | CYGWIN*" aarch64") GOAT_PLATFORM_KEY="win32-arm64" ;;
    MINGW*" x86_64" | MSYS*" x86_64" | CYGWIN*" x86_64") GOAT_PLATFORM_KEY="win32-x64" ;;
    MINGW*" amd64" | MSYS*" amd64" | CYGWIN*" amd64") GOAT_PLATFORM_KEY="win32-x64" ;;
    *) printf 'Remote host %s %s has no GOAT release archive.
' "$(uname -s)" "$(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  GOAT_ARCHIVE="goat-$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION-$GOAT_PLATFORM_KEY.tar.gz"
  case "$GOAT_PLATFORM_KEY" in win32-*) GOAT_ARCHIVE="goat-$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION-$GOAT_PLATFORM_KEY.zip" ;; esac
  GOAT_STAGING="$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.goat/runtime/goat/versions/.staging-XXXXXX")"
  goat_fetch() {
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time "$3" "$1" -o "$2"
    elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then wget -q --timeout=30 --tries=1 "$1" -O "$2"
    else printf 'Remote host needs curl or wget to download %s.\n' "$GOAT_ARCHIVE" >&2; exit 1
    fi
  }
  goat_fetch "$GOAT_RELEASE_BASE_URL/v$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION/SHA256SUMS" "$GOAT_STAGING/SHA256SUMS" 30
  goat_fetch "$GOAT_RELEASE_BASE_URL/v$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION/$GOAT_ARCHIVE" "$GOAT_STAGING/$GOAT_ARCHIVE" 240
  GOAT_EXPECTED="$(grep " \*\{0,1\}$GOAT_ARCHIVE$" "$GOAT_STAGING/SHA256SUMS" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    GOAT_ACTUAL="$(sha256sum "$GOAT_STAGING/$GOAT_ARCHIVE" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  else
    GOAT_ACTUAL="$(shasum -a 256 "$GOAT_STAGING/$GOAT_ARCHIVE" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  fi
  if [ -z "$GOAT_EXPECTED" ] || [ "$GOAT_ACTUAL" != "$GOAT_EXPECTED" ]; then
    printf 'Checksum mismatch for %s.\n' "$GOAT_ARCHIVE" >&2; exit 1
  fi
  case "$GOAT_PLATFORM_KEY" in
    win32-*) "$(cygpath -S)/tar.exe" -xf "$GOAT_STAGING/$GOAT_ARCHIVE" -C "$GOAT_STAGING" --strip-components=1 ;; # GNU tar cannot read zip.
    *) tar -xzf "$GOAT_STAGING/$GOAT_ARCHIVE" -C "$GOAT_STAGING" --strip-components=1 ;;
  esac
  rm -f "$GOAT_STAGING/$GOAT_ARCHIVE" "$GOAT_STAGING/SHA256SUMS"
  # Verify the executable and exact version before replacing a runtime,
  # including a same-version directory whose completion marker is broken.
  if ! GOAT_STAGED_VERSION_OUTPUT="$("$GOAT_STAGING/goat" --version)"; then
    printf 'The goat %s executable does not run on this host.\n' "$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION" >&2; exit 1
  fi
  if [ "$GOAT_STAGED_VERSION_OUTPUT" != "goat v$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION" ]; then
    printf 'Cannot install goat %s: expected goat v%s, but the archive executable reported "%s". The existing runtime directory and completion marker have been left unchanged. Supply the correct requested archive in the local SSH runtime archive directory or release mirror, then retry.\n' "$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION" "$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION" "$GOAT_STAGED_VERSION_OUTPUT" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  if command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    GOAT_EXECUTABLE_SHA256="$(shasum -a 256 "$GOAT_STAGING/goat" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  else
    GOAT_EXECUTABLE_SHA256="$(sha256sum "$GOAT_STAGING/goat" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  fi
  # Publish provenance with the verified executable, never backfill legacy directories.
  # The uploader names its source in the environment so run-t3.sh bytes stay source-free:
  # retained-runner identity compares those bytes across launches.
  case "${GOAT_SSH_ARCHIVE_SOURCE:-}" in
    bundle|cache|gh) GOAT_RECORD_SOURCE="$GOAT_SSH_ARCHIVE_SOURCE" ;;
    *) GOAT_RECORD_SOURCE=https ;;
  esac
  printf '%s %s %s %s\n' "$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION" "$GOAT_EXPECTED" "$GOAT_EXECUTABLE_SHA256" "$GOAT_RECORD_SOURCE" > "$GOAT_STAGING/.install-record"
  printf '%s\n' "$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION" > "$GOAT_STAGING/.install-complete"
  goat_runtime_publish "$GOAT_STAGING" "$GOAT_RUNTIME_DIR" "$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION"
fi
if [ -n "${GOAT_LOCK:-}" ]; then
  goat_lock_cleanup
  trap - 0 1 2 3 15
fi
exec 9>&-
exec "$GOAT_RUNTIME_DIR/goat" "$@"

helper_caps_old='
ERROR
  Unknown subcommand "capabilities" for "goat __ssh-helper"
'
# Sets HELPER_CAPS to the combined calls goat $1 supports, empty for none. An answer is recorded
# under the executable's key when that key holds across the call: a well-formed "caps v1" line on
# exit 0 with nothing on stderr, or an old runtime's exact unknown-subcommand failure as "caps v1".
# Anything else (another status, a signal, other or longer output) counts as none for this script.
helper_caps() {
  HELPER_CAPS=
  [ -n "$FACT_MEMO" ] && exec_fact_key "$1" || return 0
  caps_name="caps.$FACT_NAME"; caps_key="$FACT_KEY"
  if caps_line="$(fact_get "$caps_name" "$caps_key")"; then
    HELPER_CAPS="${caps_line#caps v1}"; HELPER_CAPS="${HELPER_CAPS# }"; return 0
  fi
  # The status goes to a file only this script writes; stdout to a file and stderr to the capture,
  # each through head while it is read. Neither stream's content can stand for the status or hide
  # a cut: stdout counts only under the bound, and stderr only as an exact text.
  caps_tmp="$FACT_MEMO.caps"
  : >"$caps_tmp-status" && : >"$caps_tmp-out" || return 0
  caps_err="$({ { caps_s=0; "$1" __ssh-helper capabilities 2>&3 || caps_s=$?
      printf '%s\n' "$caps_s" >"$caps_tmp-status"; } | head -c 4097 >"$caps_tmp-out"; printf . >&3; } 3>&1 | head -c 4097)" || return 0
  case "$caps_err" in *.) caps_err="${caps_err%.}" ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
  IFS= read -r caps_status <"$caps_tmp-status" || return 0
  case "$caps_status" in ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 0 ;; esac
  caps_size="$(wc -c <"$caps_tmp-out")" || return 0
  caps_size="${caps_size##* }"
  case "$caps_size" in ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 0 ;; esac
  [ "$caps_size" -le 4096 ] || return 0
  if [ "$caps_status" = 0 ] && [ -z "$caps_err" ]; then
    { IFS= read -r caps_line && ! IFS= read -r caps_more && [ -z "$caps_more" ]; } <"$caps_tmp-out" || return 0
    caps_valid "$caps_line" || return 0
  elif [ "$caps_status" = 1 ] && [ "$caps_err" = "$helper_caps_old" ]; then
    caps_line="caps v1"
  else
    return 0
  fi
  HELPER_CAPS="${caps_line#caps v1}"; HELPER_CAPS="${HELPER_CAPS# }"
  if exec_fact_key "$1" && [ "$FACT_KEY" = "$caps_key" ]; then fact_put "$caps_name" "$caps_key" "$caps_line"; fi
}
# Appends answer $3 to question $1 under key $2 to this script's memo (see frame_memo_get).
frame_memo_put() {

# True when live answer $1 names a live server on a port: then, and only then, the frame answers compat.
facts_frame_live_server() {

}
# Sets FRAME_<TAG> to each answer in the reply $3 of combined call $1 ("ok <tokens>" or
# "fail <word>"). Fails unless the whole frame is valid: its begin line, tags from $2 or compat
# each at most once, every tag in $2, compat exactly when live names a live server, and an end
# line that counts the answers with nothing after it. The capability line `facts --with-caps`
# prints may follow the begin line, well formed and uncounted; with $4 "caps" it must, listing facts.
frame_parse() {
  FRAME_MANIFEST=; FRAME_COMMIT=; FRAME_READY=; FRAME_LIVE=; FRAME_COMPAT=; FRAME_VERSION=; FRAME_OWN=
  frame_count=0
  case "$3" in "begin v1 $1$fact_nl"*) frame_rest="${3#*"$fact_nl"}" ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  frame_caps=
  case "$frame_rest" in "caps v1$fact_nl"*|"caps v1 "*)
    frame_caps="${frame_rest%%"$fact_nl"*}"; frame_rest="${frame_rest#*"$fact_nl"}"
    caps_valid "$frame_caps" || return 1 ;;
  esac
  if [ "${4:-}" = caps ]; then
    case " ${frame_caps#caps v1} " in *" facts "*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  fi
  while :; do
    case "$frame_rest" in *"$fact_nl"*) ;; *) break ;; esac
    frame_line="${frame_rest%%"$fact_nl"*}"; frame_rest="${frame_rest#*"$fact_nl"}"
    frame_tag="${frame_line%% *}"; frame_answer="${frame_line#* }"
    [ "$frame_line" = "$frame_tag $frame_answer" ] || return 1
    case " $2 compat " in *" $frame_tag "*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    case "$frame_answer" in "ok "?*|"fail error"|"fail timeout"|"fail changed"|"fail unavailable") ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    case "$frame_tag" in
      manifest) [ -z "$FRAME_MANIFEST" ] || return 1; FRAME_MANIFEST="$frame_answer" ;;
      commit) [ -z "$FRAME_COMMIT" ] || return 1; FRAME_COMMIT="$frame_answer" ;;
      ready) [ -z "$FRAME_READY" ] || return 1; FRAME_READY="$frame_answer" ;;
      live) [ -z "$FRAME_LIVE" ] || return 1; FRAME_LIVE="$frame_answer" ;;
      compat) [ -z "$FRAME_COMPAT" ] || return 1; FRAME_COMPAT="$frame_answer" ;;
      version) [ -z "$FRAME_VERSION" ] || return 1; FRAME_VERSION="$frame_answer" ;;
      own) [ -z "$FRAME_OWN" ] || return 1; FRAME_OWN="$frame_answer" ;;
      *) return 1 ;;
    esac
    frame_count=$((frame_count + 1))
  done
  [ "$frame_rest" = "end $frame_count" ] || return 1
  for frame_tag in $2; do
    case "$frame_tag" in
      manifest) [ -n "$FRAME_MANIFEST" ] ;;
      commit) [ -n "$FRAME_COMMIT" ] ;;
      ready) [ -n "$FRAME_READY" ] ;;
      live) [ -n "$FRAME_LIVE" ] ;;
      version) [ -n "$FRAME_VERSION" ] ;;
      own) [ -n "$FRAME_OWN" ] ;;
      *) false ;;
    esac || return 1
  done
  if facts_frame_live_server "$FRAME_LIVE"; then [ -n "$FRAME_COMPAT" ]; else [ -z "$FRAME_COMPAT" ]; fi
}
# Runs goat $1 with arguments $2... and sets frame_out to its reply. Succeeds only for exit status
# 0 with nothing on stderr: reads stdout to a bound (1024 characters are at most 4096 bytes) as
# lines a NUL breaks and x ends, keeps one byte of stderr, and takes the status from a file only it
# writes.
frame_direct_call() {
  : >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status" || return 1
  frame_out="$({ { "$@" 2>&1 1>&3 3>&-
      printf '%s\n' "$?" >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status"; } | head -c 1 >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-err" 3>&-; } 3>&1 |
    head -c 4097 | tr '\000' '\n'; printf x)"
  IFS= read -r frame_status <"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status" && [ "$frame_status" = 0 ] &&
    [ ! -s "$FACT_MEMO.facts-err" ] && [ "${#frame_out}" -le 1025 ] || return 1

facts_frame_compat_valid() {
  set -f; set -- $1

  case "$2" in 0|1) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$3" in ''|-|*[!$token_chars]*) return 1 ;; esac

# Declared contract extension: for the client's own runtime version reached through the candidate
# runner this launch just wrote and pinned, facts --version, --own and --live answer as --version,
# protocol --shell and protocol --runtime-file ... --shell do (the same functions in apps/server,
# pinned by its contract test). So one start asks the questions not yet answered, when two or
# more are missing, and its answers are recorded under the rules of the calls they stand for:
# version and own under the pin's exec key, which holds its digest, so a young pin rewritten within
# its second misses; live only as live_fact would keep it, bound to a live key that held across the
# call or, for no server, in this script's memo, which live_fact reads only while all three files
# stay absent. Any other runner, a changed exec key or live input, or any invalid answer records
# nothing, leaves no marker, and the separate calls run as before.
launch_want() { launch_asks="$launch_asks --$1"; launch_tags="$launch_tags $1"; launch_count=$((launch_count + 1)); }
launch_facts_ask() {
  [ -n "$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION" ] && [ "$OWNING_LAUNCH" = 1 ] && [ "$PRESERVE_SELECTED_RUNNER" = 0 ] &&
    [ -n "$FACT_MEMO" ] || return 0
  launch_pin="$RUNNER_CANDIDATE_FILE.pin"
  runner_key_hints "$launch_pin"
  [ -z "$RUNNER_NODE_DECLARED" ] && [ "$RUNNER_ARCHIVE_VERSION" = "$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION" ] || return 0
  exec_fact_key "$launch_pin" && [ "$FACT_NAME" = "$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION.runner" ] || return 0
  launch_name="$FACT_NAME"; launch_key="$FACT_KEY"; launch_exec="$FACT_NAME $FACT_KEY"
  launch_asks=; launch_tags=; launch_count=0; launch_absent=; launch_live=
  fact_get "version.$launch_name" "$launch_key" >/dev/null || launch_want version
  fact_get "own.$launch_name" "$launch_key" >/dev/null || launch_want own
  # One missing question at most: its separate call costs what the frame would, without the live key.
  [ "$launch_count" -ge 1 ] || return 0
  if live_none_absent "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE"; then
    launch_absent=1
    live_none_get "$launch_exec" >/dev/null || launch_want live
  elif live_fact_key "$launch_pin" "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE"; then
    launch_live="$FACT_KEY"
    fact_get "live.$launch_name" "$launch_live" >/dev/null || launch_want live
  fi
  [ "$launch_count" -ge 2 ] || return 0
  frame_direct_call "$launch_pin" __ssh-helper facts --with-caps $launch_asks --runtime-file "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" --port-file "$PORT_FILE" --pid-file "$PID_FILE" || return 0
  exec_fact_key "$launch_pin" && [ "$FACT_NAME $FACT_KEY" = "$launch_exec" ] || return 0
  launch_held=
  if [ -n "$launch_absent" ]; then
    ! live_none_absent "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE" || launch_held=absent
  elif [ -n "$launch_live" ] && live_fact_key "$launch_pin" "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE" &&
       [ "$FACT_KEY" = "$launch_live" ]; then
    launch_held=live
  fi
  case " $launch_tags " in *" live "*) [ -n "$launch_held" ] || return 0 ;; esac
  frame_parse facts "$launch_tags" "$frame_out" caps || return 0
  case " $launch_tags " in *" version "*) [ "$FRAME_VERSION" = "ok goat v$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION" ] || return 0 ;; esac
  case " $launch_tags " in *" own "*)
    case "$FRAME_OWN" in "ok $OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION "*) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
    (set -f; set -- ${FRAME_OWN#ok }; valid_own_tokens "$@") || return 0 ;;
  esac
  case " $launch_tags " in *" live "*)
    case "$FRAME_LIVE" in "ok "*) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
    (set -f; set -- ${FRAME_LIVE#ok }; valid_live_tokens "$@") || return 0 ;;
  esac
  [ -z "$FRAME_VERSION" ] || fact_put "version.$launch_name" "$launch_key" "${FRAME_VERSION#ok }"
  [ -z "$FRAME_OWN" ] || fact_put "own.$launch_name" "$launch_key" "${FRAME_OWN#ok }"
  case "$launch_held $FRAME_LIVE" in
    "absent ok none unknown unknown unknown 0 0") frame_memo_put live-none "$launch_exec" "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }" ;;
    "live ok live "*)
      facts_frame_live_ids "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }"
      if fact_valid live "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }" && fact_bound "$frame_pid" "$frame_port"; then
        fact_put "live.$launch_name" "$launch_live" "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }"
      fi ;;
  esac
}

check_retained_runner() {
  # Recovery pins the executable observed by the probe as well as the runner.
  if [ -n "$EXPECTED_INSTALLED_SHA256" ] &&
     [ "$(runner_sha256 "$HOME/.goat/runtime/goat/versions/$SELECTED_VERSION/goat")" != "$EXPECTED_INSTALLED_SHA256" ]; then
    printf 'Recorded GOAT executable changed since probe; reconnect.\n' >&2; exit 1
  fi
  if [ "$RUNNER_PUBLISHED" = 0 ] && [ -n "$EXPECTED_LIVE_RUNNER_SHA256" ] &&
     [ "$(runner_sha256 "$RUNNER_FILE")" != "$EXPECTED_LIVE_RUNNER_SHA256" ]; then
    printf 'Running runner changed before publication; process was preserved.\n' >&2; exit 1
  fi
  if [ "$PRESERVE_SELECTED_RUNNER" = 1 ]; then
    if [ -z "$EXPECTED_RETAINED_SHA256" ] || [ ! -f "$RUNNER_FILE" ] ||
       [ "$(runner_sha256 "$RUNNER_FILE")" != "$EXPECTED_RETAINED_SHA256" ]; then
      printf 'Selected retained GOAT runner bytes changed since probe; reconnect to prepare again.\n' >&2; exit 1
    fi
  fi
}

LOCK="$DEFAULT_SERVER_HOME/ssh-launch/replacement.lock"
RECOVERY="$DEFAULT_SERVER_HOME/ssh-launch/replacement.recovery"
LOCK_HELD=0; OWNER=; LOCK_DETAIL=
release_replacement_lock() {
  if [ -n "$OWNER" ] && [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then rm -f "$LOCK"; fi
  LOCK_HELD=0
}
release_recovery_lock() {
  if [ -n "$OWNER" ] && [ "$(readlink "$RECOVERY" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then rm -f "$RECOVERY"; fi
}
owner_proven_dead() {
  recorded="$1"
  old_ifs="$IFS"; IFS='|'; set -f; set -- $recorded; IFS="$old_ifs"
  [ "$#" = 5 ] && [ "$1" = "$LOCK_HOST" ] && [ "$2" = "$LOCK_UID" ] &&
    valid_positive "$3" && [ -n "$4" ] && [ -n "$5" ] || return 1
  owner_pid="$3"; owner_start="$4"
  # Failure to inspect the process table is not proof of death (nor is age).
  presence="$(process_presence "$owner_pid")" || return 1
  case "$presence" in absent) return 0 ;; present) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  current_start="$(process_start "$owner_pid")" || return 1

acquire_replacement_lock() {
  if [ "$LOCK_HELD" = 1 ] && [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then return 0; fi
  LOCK_HOST="$(uname -n 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  LOCK_UID="$(id -u 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  LOCK_START="$(process_start "$$")" || return 1
  [ -n "$LOCK_HOST" ] && [ -n "$LOCK_UID" ] && [ -n "$LOCK_START" ] || return 1
  nonce_dir="$(mktemp -d "$STATE_DIR/lock-owner-XXXXXX")" || return 1
  NONCE="$(basename "$nonce_dir")"
  rmdir "$nonce_dir" || return 1
  OWNER="$LOCK_HOST|$LOCK_UID|$$|$LOCK_START|$NONCE"
  mkdir -p "$DEFAULT_SERVER_HOME/ssh-launch"
  if [ ! -d "$LOCK" ] && ln -s "$OWNER" "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null &&
     [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then LOCK_HELD=1; return 0; fi
  dead_owner="$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  owner_proven_dead "$dead_owner" || return 1

     [ "$(readlink "$RECOVERY" 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$OWNER" ]; then
    printf 'Recovery is locked; remove %s after checking that no GOAT client is replacing this runtime.\n' "$RECOVERY" >&2
    LOCK_DETAIL=recovery-stale
    return 1
  fi
  # Only serialized recoverers can remove a dead owner's unchanged link.
  if [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$dead_owner" ] && owner_proven_dead "$dead_owner"; then rm -f "$LOCK"; fi
  release_recovery_lock
  if [ ! -d "$LOCK" ] && ln -s "$OWNER" "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null &&
     [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then LOCK_HELD=1; return 0; fi

wait_for_replacement_lock() {

    old_ifs="$IFS"; IFS='|'; set -f; set -- $waiting_owner; IFS="$old_ifs"

      valid_positive "$3" && [ -n "$4" ] && [ -n "$5" ] || return 1

    [ "$(process_start "$3" 2>/dev/null)" = "$4" ] || return 1
    replacement_wait=$((replacement_wait + 1))
    sleep 0.1
  done

check_live_protocol() {

  fi

    if forced_target_recorded "$LIVE_PID" "$LIVE_PORT"; then select_forced_stop
    elif [ "$REFRESH_IF_IDLE" = 1 ] && [ "$LIVE_COMPATIBLE" = 1 ] && [ "$LIVE_OWNED" = 1 ] &&
       { [ "$REPLACEMENT_REASON" = older ] || [ "$REPLACEMENT_REASON" = capability ]; }; then

fact_memo_get() {

        [ "$FILE_SIG2" = "$memo_sig" ] || return 1

      file_sig_set "$memo_exe" && [ "$FILE_SIG" = "$memo_sig" ] || return 1
    fi

helper_caps_old='
ERROR
  Unknown subcommand "capabilities" for "goat __ssh-helper"
'
# Sets HELPER_CAPS to the combined calls goat $1 supports, empty for none. An answer is recorded
# under the executable's key when that key holds across the call: a well-formed "caps v1" line on
# exit 0 with nothing on stderr, or an old runtime's exact unknown-subcommand failure as "caps v1".
# Anything else (another status, a signal, other or longer output) counts as none for this script.
helper_caps() {
  HELPER_CAPS=
  [ -n "$FACT_MEMO" ] && exec_fact_key "$1" || return 0
  caps_name="caps.$FACT_NAME"; caps_key="$FACT_KEY"
  if caps_line="$(fact_get "$caps_name" "$caps_key")"; then
    HELPER_CAPS="${caps_line#caps v1}"; HELPER_CAPS="${HELPER_CAPS# }"; return 0
  fi
  # The status goes to a file only this script writes; stdout to a file and stderr to the capture,
  # each through head while it is read. Neither stream's content can stand for the status or hide
  # a cut: stdout counts only under the bound, and stderr only as an exact text.
  caps_tmp="$FACT_MEMO.caps"
  : >"$caps_tmp-status" && : >"$caps_tmp-out" || return 0
  caps_err="$({ { caps_s=0; "$1" __ssh-helper capabilities 2>&3 || caps_s=$?
      printf '%s\n' "$caps_s" >"$caps_tmp-status"; } | head -c 4097 >"$caps_tmp-out"; printf . >&3; } 3>&1 | head -c 4097)" || return 0
  case "$caps_err" in *.) caps_err="${caps_err%.}" ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
  IFS= read -r caps_status <"$caps_tmp-status" || return 0
  case "$caps_status" in ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 0 ;; esac
  caps_size="$(wc -c <"$caps_tmp-out")" || return 0
  caps_size="${caps_size##* }"
  case "$caps_size" in ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 0 ;; esac
  [ "$caps_size" -le 4096 ] || return 0
  if [ "$caps_status" = 0 ] && [ -z "$caps_err" ]; then
    { IFS= read -r caps_line && ! IFS= read -r caps_more && [ -z "$caps_more" ]; } <"$caps_tmp-out" || return 0
    caps_valid "$caps_line" || return 0
  elif [ "$caps_status" = 1 ] && [ "$caps_err" = "$helper_caps_old" ]; then
    caps_line="caps v1"
  else
    return 0
  fi
  HELPER_CAPS="${caps_line#caps v1}"; HELPER_CAPS="${HELPER_CAPS# }"
  if exec_fact_key "$1" && [ "$FACT_KEY" = "$caps_key" ]; then fact_put "$caps_name" "$caps_key" "$caps_line"; fi
}
# Appends answer $3 to question $1 under key $2 to this script's memo (see frame_memo_get).
frame_memo_put() {

# True when live answer $1 names a live server on a port: then, and only then, the frame answers compat.
facts_frame_live_server() {

  valid_live_tokens "$@" && [ "$1" = live ]
}
# Sets FRAME_<TAG> to each answer in the reply $3 of combined call $1 ("ok <tokens>" or
# "fail <word>"). Fails unless the whole frame is valid: its begin line, tags from $2 or compat
# each at most once, every tag in $2, compat exactly when live names a live server, and an end
# line that counts the answers with nothing after it. The capability line `facts --with-caps`
# prints may follow the begin line, well formed and uncounted; with $4 "caps" it must, listing facts.
frame_parse() {
  FRAME_MANIFEST=; FRAME_COMMIT=; FRAME_READY=; FRAME_LIVE=; FRAME_COMPAT=; FRAME_VERSION=; FRAME_OWN=
  frame_count=0
  case "$3" in "begin v1 $1$fact_nl"*) frame_rest="${3#*"$fact_nl"}" ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  frame_caps=
  case "$frame_rest" in "caps v1$fact_nl"*|"caps v1 "*)
    frame_caps="${frame_rest%%"$fact_nl"*}"; frame_rest="${frame_rest#*"$fact_nl"}"
    caps_valid "$frame_caps" || return 1 ;;
  esac
  if [ "${4:-}" = caps ]; then
    case " ${frame_caps#caps v1} " in *" facts "*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  fi
  while :; do
    case "$frame_rest" in *"$fact_nl"*) ;; *) break ;; esac
    frame_line="${frame_rest%%"$fact_nl"*}"; frame_rest="${frame_rest#*"$fact_nl"}"
    frame_tag="${frame_line%% *}"; frame_answer="${frame_line#* }"
    [ "$frame_line" = "$frame_tag $frame_answer" ] || return 1
    case " $2 compat " in *" $frame_tag "*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    case "$frame_answer" in "ok "?*|"fail error"|"fail timeout"|"fail changed"|"fail unavailable") ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    case "$frame_tag" in
      manifest) [ -z "$FRAME_MANIFEST" ] || return 1; FRAME_MANIFEST="$frame_answer" ;;
      commit) [ -z "$FRAME_COMMIT" ] || return 1; FRAME_COMMIT="$frame_answer" ;;
      ready) [ -z "$FRAME_READY" ] || return 1; FRAME_READY="$frame_answer" ;;
      live) [ -z "$FRAME_LIVE" ] || return 1; FRAME_LIVE="$frame_answer" ;;
      compat) [ -z "$FRAME_COMPAT" ] || return 1; FRAME_COMPAT="$frame_answer" ;;
      version) [ -z "$FRAME_VERSION" ] || return 1; FRAME_VERSION="$frame_answer" ;;
      own) [ -z "$FRAME_OWN" ] || return 1; FRAME_OWN="$frame_answer" ;;
      *) return 1 ;;
    esac
    frame_count=$((frame_count + 1))
  done
  [ "$frame_rest" = "end $frame_count" ] || return 1
  for frame_tag in $2; do
    case "$frame_tag" in
      manifest) [ -n "$FRAME_MANIFEST" ] ;;
      commit) [ -n "$FRAME_COMMIT" ] ;;
      ready) [ -n "$FRAME_READY" ] ;;
      live) [ -n "$FRAME_LIVE" ] ;;
      version) [ -n "$FRAME_VERSION" ] ;;
      own) [ -n "$FRAME_OWN" ] ;;
      *) false ;;
    esac || return 1
  done
  if facts_frame_live_server "$FRAME_LIVE"; then [ -n "$FRAME_COMPAT" ]; else [ -z "$FRAME_COMPAT" ]; fi
}
# Runs goat $1 with arguments $2... and sets frame_out to its reply. Succeeds only for exit status
# 0 with nothing on stderr: reads stdout to a bound (1024 characters are at most 4096 bytes) as
# lines a NUL breaks and x ends, keeps one byte of stderr, and takes the status from a file only it
# writes.
frame_direct_call() {
  : >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status" || return 1
  frame_out="$({ { "$@" 2>&1 1>&3 3>&-
      printf '%s\n' "$?" >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status"; } | head -c 1 >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-err" 3>&-; } 3>&1 |
    head -c 4097 | tr '\000' '\n'; printf x)"
  IFS= read -r frame_status <"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status" && [ "$frame_status" = 0 ] &&
    [ ! -s "$FACT_MEMO.facts-err" ] && [ "${#frame_out}" -le 1025 ] || return 1

facts_frame_compat_valid() {
  set -f; set -- $1
  [ "$#" = 3 ] || return 1
  case "$1" in compatible|update-required|client-too-old|unknown) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$2" in 0|1) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$3" in ''|-|*[!$token_chars]*) return 1 ;; esac

# Declared contract extension: for the client's own runtime version reached through the candidate
# runner this launch just wrote and pinned, facts --version, --own and --live answer as --version,
# protocol --shell and protocol --runtime-file ... --shell do (the same functions in apps/server,
# pinned by its contract test). So one start asks the questions not yet answered, when two or
# more are missing, and its answers are recorded under the rules of the calls they stand for:
# version and own under the pin's exec key, which holds its digest, so a young pin rewritten within
# its second misses; live only as live_fact would keep it, bound to a live key that held across the
# call or, for no server, in this script's memo, which live_fact reads only while all three files
# stay absent. Any other runner, a changed exec key or live input, or any invalid answer records
# nothing, leaves no marker, and the separate calls run as before.
launch_want() { launch_asks="$launch_asks --$1"; launch_tags="$launch_tags $1"; launch_count=$((launch_count + 1)); }
launch_facts_ask() {
  [ -n "$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION" ] && [ "$OWNING_LAUNCH" = 1 ] && [ "$PRESERVE_SELECTED_RUNNER" = 0 ] &&
    [ -n "$FACT_MEMO" ] || return 0
  launch_pin="$RUNNER_CANDIDATE_FILE.pin"
  runner_key_hints "$launch_pin"
  [ -z "$RUNNER_NODE_DECLARED" ] && [ "$RUNNER_ARCHIVE_VERSION" = "$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION" ] || return 0
  exec_fact_key "$launch_pin" && [ "$FACT_NAME" = "$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION.runner" ] || return 0
  launch_name="$FACT_NAME"; launch_key="$FACT_KEY"; launch_exec="$FACT_NAME $FACT_KEY"
  launch_asks=; launch_tags=; launch_count=0; launch_absent=; launch_live=
  fact_get "version.$launch_name" "$launch_key" >/dev/null || launch_want version
  fact_get "own.$launch_name" "$launch_key" >/dev/null || launch_want own
  # One missing question at most: its separate call costs what the frame would, without the live key.
  [ "$launch_count" -ge 1 ] || return 0
  if live_none_absent "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE"; then
    launch_absent=1
    live_none_get "$launch_exec" >/dev/null || launch_want live
  elif live_fact_key "$launch_pin" "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE"; then
    launch_live="$FACT_KEY"
    fact_get "live.$launch_name" "$launch_live" >/dev/null || launch_want live
  fi
  [ "$launch_count" -ge 2 ] || return 0
  frame_direct_call "$launch_pin" __ssh-helper facts --with-caps $launch_asks --runtime-file "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" --port-file "$PORT_FILE" --pid-file "$PID_FILE" || return 0
  exec_fact_key "$launch_pin" && [ "$FACT_NAME $FACT_KEY" = "$launch_exec" ] || return 0
  launch_held=
  if [ -n "$launch_absent" ]; then
    ! live_none_absent "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE" || launch_held=absent
  elif [ -n "$launch_live" ] && live_fact_key "$launch_pin" "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE" &&
       [ "$FACT_KEY" = "$launch_live" ]; then
    launch_held=live
  fi
  case " $launch_tags " in *" live "*) [ -n "$launch_held" ] || return 0 ;; esac
  frame_parse facts "$launch_tags" "$frame_out" caps || return 0
  case " $launch_tags " in *" version "*) [ "$FRAME_VERSION" = "ok goat v$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION" ] || return 0 ;; esac
  case " $launch_tags " in *" own "*)
    case "$FRAME_OWN" in "ok $OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION "*) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
    (set -f; set -- ${FRAME_OWN#ok }; valid_own_tokens "$@") || return 0 ;;
  esac
  case " $launch_tags " in *" live "*)
    case "$FRAME_LIVE" in "ok "*) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
    (set -f; set -- ${FRAME_LIVE#ok }; valid_live_tokens "$@") || return 0 ;;
  esac
  [ -z "$FRAME_VERSION" ] || fact_put "version.$launch_name" "$launch_key" "${FRAME_VERSION#ok }"
  [ -z "$FRAME_OWN" ] || fact_put "own.$launch_name" "$launch_key" "${FRAME_OWN#ok }"
  case "$launch_held $FRAME_LIVE" in
    "absent ok none unknown unknown unknown 0 0") frame_memo_put live-none "$launch_exec" "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }" ;;
    "live ok live "*)
      facts_frame_live_ids "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }"
      if fact_valid live "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }" && fact_bound "$frame_pid" "$frame_port"; then
        fact_put "live.$launch_name" "$launch_live" "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }"
      fi ;;
  esac
}

check_retained_runner() {
  # Recovery pins the executable observed by the probe as well as the runner.
  if [ -n "$EXPECTED_INSTALLED_SHA256" ] &&
     [ "$(runner_sha256 "$HOME/.goat/runtime/goat/versions/$SELECTED_VERSION/goat")" != "$EXPECTED_INSTALLED_SHA256" ]; then
    printf 'Recorded GOAT executable changed since probe; reconnect.\n' >&2; exit 1
  fi
  if [ "$RUNNER_PUBLISHED" = 0 ] && [ -n "$EXPECTED_LIVE_RUNNER_SHA256" ] &&
     [ "$(runner_sha256 "$RUNNER_FILE")" != "$EXPECTED_LIVE_RUNNER_SHA256" ]; then
    printf 'Running runner changed before publication; process was preserved.\n' >&2; exit 1
  fi
  if [ "$PRESERVE_SELECTED_RUNNER" = 1 ]; then
    if [ -z "$EXPECTED_RETAINED_SHA256" ] || [ ! -f "$RUNNER_FILE" ] ||
       [ "$(runner_sha256 "$RUNNER_FILE")" != "$EXPECTED_RETAINED_SHA256" ]; then
      printf 'Selected retained GOAT runner bytes changed since probe; reconnect to prepare again.\n' >&2; exit 1
    fi
  fi
}

LOCK="$DEFAULT_SERVER_HOME/ssh-launch/replacement.lock"
RECOVERY="$DEFAULT_SERVER_HOME/ssh-launch/replacement.recovery"
LOCK_HELD=0; OWNER=; LOCK_DETAIL=
release_replacement_lock() {
  if [ -n "$OWNER" ] && [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then rm -f "$LOCK"; fi
  LOCK_HELD=0
}
release_recovery_lock() {
  if [ -n "$OWNER" ] && [ "$(readlink "$RECOVERY" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then rm -f "$RECOVERY"; fi
}
owner_proven_dead() {
  recorded="$1"
  old_ifs="$IFS"; IFS='|'; set -f; set -- $recorded; IFS="$old_ifs"
  [ "$#" = 5 ] && [ "$1" = "$LOCK_HOST" ] && [ "$2" = "$LOCK_UID" ] &&
    valid_positive "$3" && [ -n "$4" ] && [ -n "$5" ] || return 1
  owner_pid="$3"; owner_start="$4"
  # Failure to inspect the process table is not proof of death (nor is age).
  presence="$(process_presence "$owner_pid")" || return 1
  case "$presence" in absent) return 0 ;; present) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  current_start="$(process_start "$owner_pid")" || return 1

}
acquire_replacement_lock() {
  if [ "$LOCK_HELD" = 1 ] && [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then return 0; fi
  LOCK_HOST="$(uname -n 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  LOCK_UID="$(id -u 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  LOCK_START="$(process_start "$$")" || return 1
  [ -n "$LOCK_HOST" ] && [ -n "$LOCK_UID" ] && [ -n "$LOCK_START" ] || return 1
  nonce_dir="$(mktemp -d "$STATE_DIR/lock-owner-XXXXXX")" || return 1
  NONCE="$(basename "$nonce_dir")"
  rmdir "$nonce_dir" || return 1
  OWNER="$LOCK_HOST|$LOCK_UID|$$|$LOCK_START|$NONCE"
  mkdir -p "$DEFAULT_SERVER_HOME/ssh-launch"
  if [ ! -d "$LOCK" ] && ln -s "$OWNER" "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null &&
     [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then LOCK_HELD=1; return 0; fi
  dead_owner="$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  owner_proven_dead "$dead_owner" || return 1
  if [ -d "$RECOVERY" ] || ! ln -s "$OWNER" "$RECOVERY" 2>/dev/null ||
     [ "$(readlink "$RECOVERY" 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$OWNER" ]; then
    printf 'Recovery is locked; remove %s after checking that no GOAT client is replacing this runtime.\n' "$RECOVERY" >&2
    LOCK_DETAIL=recovery-stale
    return 1
  fi
  # Only serialized recoverers can remove a dead owner's unchanged link.
  if [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$dead_owner" ] && owner_proven_dead "$dead_owner"; then rm -f "$LOCK"; fi
  release_recovery_lock
  if [ ! -d "$LOCK" ] && ln -s "$OWNER" "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null &&
     [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then LOCK_HELD=1; return 0; fi

}
wait_for_replacement_lock() {

    old_ifs="$IFS"; IFS='|'; set -f; set -- $waiting_owner; IFS="$old_ifs"
    [ "$#" = 5 ] && [ "$1" = "$(uname -n)" ] && [ "$2" = "$(id -u)" ] &&
      valid_positive "$3" && [ -n "$4" ] && [ -n "$5" ] || return 1
    # Only a proven local owner can make progress; foreign or ambiguous locks stay pending.
    [ "$(process_start "$3" 2>/dev/null)" = "$4" ] || return 1
    replacement_wait=$((replacement_wait + 1))
    sleep 0.1
  done
}

        case ">":

        case "<=":

# Records that name a live process belong to someone: another server, an older client's
# per-client directory, or an ownership change in progress. Attaching to a foreign server
# removes its PID file, so a lost-records server has none.
managed_orphan() {

  case "$(uname -s)" in MINGW*|MSYS*|CYGWIN*) return 1 ;; esac
  valid_positive "$orphan_pid" && valid_positive "$orphan_port" && valid_port "$orphan_port" &&
    valid_version "$orphan_version" || return 1

    orphan_recorded="$(cat "$orphan_record" 2>/dev/null || true)"

      [ "$orphan_noglob" = 0 ] || set -f

  orphan_uid="$(ps -o uid= -p "$orphan_pid" 2>/dev/null | awk 'NF==1 { print $1 }')"
  [ -n "$orphan_uid" ] && [ "$orphan_uid" = "$(id -u)" ] || return 1

runner_hint_set() {

  caps_size="$(wc -c <"$caps_tmp-out")" || return 0
  caps_size="${caps_size##* }"
  case "$caps_size" in ''|*[!0123456789]*) return 0 ;; esac
  [ "$caps_size" -le 4096 ] || return 0

    { IFS= read -r caps_line && ! IFS= read -r caps_more && [ -z "$caps_more" ]; } <"$caps_tmp-out" || return 0
    caps_valid "$caps_line" || return 0
  elif [ "$caps_status" = 1 ] && [ "$caps_err" = "$helper_caps_old" ]; then
    caps_line="caps v1"
  else
    return 0
  fi
  HELPER_CAPS="${caps_line#caps v1}"; HELPER_CAPS="${HELPER_CAPS# }"
  if exec_fact_key "$1" && [ "$FACT_KEY" = "$caps_key" ]; then fact_put "$caps_name" "$caps_key" "$caps_line"; fi
}
# Appends answer $3 to question $1 under key $2 to this script's memo (see frame_memo_get).
frame_memo_put() {
  case "$1$2$3" in *"$fact_nl"*) return 0 ;; esac

# True when live answer $1 names a live server on a port: then, and only then, the frame answers compat.
facts_frame_live_server() {

}
# Sets FRAME_<TAG> to each answer in the reply $3 of combined call $1 ("ok <tokens>" or
# "fail <word>"). Fails unless the whole frame is valid: its begin line, tags from $2 or compat
# each at most once, every tag in $2, compat exactly when live names a live server, and an end
# line that counts the answers with nothing after it. The capability line `facts --with-caps`
# prints may follow the begin line, well formed and uncounted; with $4 "caps" it must, listing facts.
frame_parse() {
  FRAME_MANIFEST=; FRAME_COMMIT=; FRAME_READY=; FRAME_LIVE=; FRAME_COMPAT=; FRAME_VERSION=; FRAME_OWN=
  frame_count=0
  case "$3" in "begin v1 $1$fact_nl"*) frame_rest="${3#*"$fact_nl"}" ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  frame_caps=
  case "$frame_rest" in "caps v1$fact_nl"*|"caps v1 "*)
    frame_caps="${frame_rest%%"$fact_nl"*}"; frame_rest="${frame_rest#*"$fact_nl"}"
    caps_valid "$frame_caps" || return 1 ;;
  esac
  if [ "${4:-}" = caps ]; then
    case " ${frame_caps#caps v1} " in *" facts "*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  fi
  while :; do
    case "$frame_rest" in *"$fact_nl"*) ;; *) break ;; esac
    frame_line="${frame_rest%%"$fact_nl"*}"; frame_rest="${frame_rest#*"$fact_nl"}"
    frame_tag="${frame_line%% *}"; frame_answer="${frame_line#* }"
    [ "$frame_line" = "$frame_tag $frame_answer" ] || return 1
    case " $2 compat " in *" $frame_tag "*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    case "$frame_answer" in "ok "?*|"fail error"|"fail timeout"|"fail changed"|"fail unavailable") ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    case "$frame_tag" in
      manifest) [ -z "$FRAME_MANIFEST" ] || return 1; FRAME_MANIFEST="$frame_answer" ;;
      commit) [ -z "$FRAME_COMMIT" ] || return 1; FRAME_COMMIT="$frame_answer" ;;
      ready) [ -z "$FRAME_READY" ] || return 1; FRAME_READY="$frame_answer" ;;
      live) [ -z "$FRAME_LIVE" ] || return 1; FRAME_LIVE="$frame_answer" ;;
      compat) [ -z "$FRAME_COMPAT" ] || return 1; FRAME_COMPAT="$frame_answer" ;;
      version) [ -z "$FRAME_VERSION" ] || return 1; FRAME_VERSION="$frame_answer" ;;
      own) [ -z "$FRAME_OWN" ] || return 1; FRAME_OWN="$frame_answer" ;;
      *) return 1 ;;
    esac
    frame_count=$((frame_count + 1))
  done
  [ "$frame_rest" = "end $frame_count" ] || return 1
  for frame_tag in $2; do
    case "$frame_tag" in
      manifest) [ -n "$FRAME_MANIFEST" ] ;;
      commit) [ -n "$FRAME_COMMIT" ] ;;
      ready) [ -n "$FRAME_READY" ] ;;
      live) [ -n "$FRAME_LIVE" ] ;;
      version) [ -n "$FRAME_VERSION" ] ;;
      own) [ -n "$FRAME_OWN" ] ;;
      *) false ;;
    esac || return 1
  done
  if facts_frame_live_server "$FRAME_LIVE"; then [ -n "$FRAME_COMPAT" ]; else [ -z "$FRAME_COMPAT" ]; fi
}
# Runs goat $1 with arguments $2... and sets frame_out to its reply. Succeeds only for exit status
# 0 with nothing on stderr: reads stdout to a bound (1024 characters are at most 4096 bytes) as
# lines a NUL breaks and x ends, keeps one byte of stderr, and takes the status from a file only it
# writes.
frame_direct_call() {
  : >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status" || return 1
  frame_out="$({ { "$@" 2>&1 1>&3 3>&-
      printf '%s\n' "$?" >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status"; } | head -c 1 >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-err" 3>&-; } 3>&1 |
    head -c 4097 | tr '\000' '\n'; printf x)"
  IFS= read -r frame_status <"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status" && [ "$frame_status" = 0 ] &&
    [ ! -s "$FACT_MEMO.facts-err" ] && [ "${#frame_out}" -le 1025 ] || return 1
  case "$frame_out" in *"$fact_nl"x) frame_out="${frame_out%"$fact_nl"x}" ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
}

facts_frame_compat_valid() {
  set -f; set -- $1
  [ "$#" = 3 ] || return 1
  case "$1" in compatible|update-required|client-too-old|unknown) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$2" in 0|1) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$3" in ''|-|*[!$token_chars]*) return 1 ;; esac
}

# Declared contract extension: for the client's own runtime version reached through the candidate
# runner this launch just wrote and pinned, facts --version, --own and --live answer as --version,
# protocol --shell and protocol --runtime-file ... --shell do (the same functions in apps/server,
# pinned by its contract test). So one start asks the questions not yet answered, when two or
# more are missing, and its answers are recorded under the rules of the calls they stand for:
# version and own under the pin's exec key, which holds its digest, so a young pin rewritten within
# its second misses; live only as live_fact would keep it, bound to a live key that held across the
# call or, for no server, in this script's memo, which live_fact reads only while all three files
# stay absent. Any other runner, a changed exec key or live input, or any invalid answer records
# nothing, leaves no marker, and the separate calls run as before.
launch_want() { launch_asks="$launch_asks --$1"; launch_tags="$launch_tags $1"; launch_count=$((launch_count + 1)); }
launch_facts_ask() {

    [ -n "$FACT_MEMO" ] || return 0
  launch_pin="$RUNNER_CANDIDATE_FILE.pin"

  exec_fact_key "$launch_pin" && [ "$FACT_NAME" = "$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION.runner" ] || return 0
  launch_name="$FACT_NAME"; launch_key="$FACT_KEY"; launch_exec="$FACT_NAME $FACT_KEY"
  launch_asks=; launch_tags=; launch_count=0; launch_absent=; launch_live=
  fact_get "version.$launch_name" "$launch_key" >/dev/null || launch_want version
  fact_get "own.$launch_name" "$launch_key" >/dev/null || launch_want own
  # One missing question at most: its separate call costs what the frame would, without the live key.
  [ "$launch_count" -ge 1 ] || return 0

    launch_absent=1
    live_none_get "$launch_exec" >/dev/null || launch_want live
  elif live_fact_key "$launch_pin" "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE"; then
    launch_live="$FACT_KEY"
    fact_get "live.$launch_name" "$launch_live" >/dev/null || launch_want live
  fi
  [ "$launch_count" -ge 2 ] || return 0
  frame_direct_call "$launch_pin" __ssh-helper facts --with-caps $launch_asks --runtime-file "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" --port-file "$PORT_FILE" --pid-file "$PID_FILE" || return 0
  exec_fact_key "$launch_pin" && [ "$FACT_NAME $FACT_KEY" = "$launch_exec" ] || return 0
  launch_held=
  if [ -n "$launch_absent" ]; then
    ! live_none_absent "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE" || launch_held=absent
  elif [ -n "$launch_live" ] && live_fact_key "$launch_pin" "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE" &&
       [ "$FACT_KEY" = "$launch_live" ]; then
    launch_held=live
  fi
  case " $launch_tags " in *" live "*) [ -n "$launch_held" ] || return 0 ;; esac
  frame_parse facts "$launch_tags" "$frame_out" caps || return 0
  case " $launch_tags " in *" version "*) [ "$FRAME_VERSION" = "ok goat v$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION" ] || return 0 ;; esac
  case " $launch_tags " in *" own "*)
    case "$FRAME_OWN" in "ok $OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION "*) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
    (set -f; set -- ${FRAME_OWN#ok }; valid_own_tokens "$@") || return 0 ;;
  esac
  case " $launch_tags " in *" live "*)
    case "$FRAME_LIVE" in "ok "*) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
    (set -f; set -- ${FRAME_LIVE#ok }; valid_live_tokens "$@") || return 0 ;;
  esac
  [ -z "$FRAME_VERSION" ] || fact_put "version.$launch_name" "$launch_key" "${FRAME_VERSION#ok }"
  [ -z "$FRAME_OWN" ] || fact_put "own.$launch_name" "$launch_key" "${FRAME_OWN#ok }"
  case "$launch_held $FRAME_LIVE" in
    "absent ok none unknown unknown unknown 0 0") frame_memo_put live-none "$launch_exec" "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }" ;;
    "live ok live "*)
      facts_frame_live_ids "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }"

        fact_put "live.$launch_name" "$launch_live" "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }"

}

     [ "$(runner_sha256 "$RUNNER_FILE")" != "$EXPECTED_LIVE_RUNNER_SHA256" ]; then

LOCK="$DEFAULT_SERVER_HOME/ssh-launch/replacement.lock"

LOCK_HELD=0; OWNER=; LOCK_DETAIL=

release_recovery_lock() {

owner_proven_dead() {
  recorded="$1"

    valid_positive "$3" && [ -n "$4" ] && [ -n "$5" ] || return 1

  LOCK_UID="$(id -u 2>/dev/null)" || return 1

  NONCE="$(basename "$nonce_dir")"

     [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then LOCK_HELD=1; return 0; fi
  dead_owner="$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null)" || return 1
  owner_proven_dead "$dead_owner" || return 1

     [ "$(readlink "$RECOVERY" 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$OWNER" ]; then

    LOCK_DETAIL=recovery-stale

  release_recovery_lock
  if [ ! -d "$LOCK" ] && ln -s "$OWNER" "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null &&
     [ "$(readlink "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "$OWNER" ]; then LOCK_HELD=1; return 0; fi

    old_ifs="$IFS"; IFS='|'; set -f; set -- $waiting_owner; IFS="$old_ifs"

    [ "$(process_start "$3" 2>/dev/null)" = "$4" ] || return 1

# End of the declarations GOAT reads without running this runner.
goat_runtime_fs() (
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    MINGW* | MSYS* | CYGWIN*) ;;
    *) "$@"; exit $? ;;
  esac
  # mv nests a stage in an existing directory; GNU -T renames onto an empty one, refuses the rest.
  if [ "$1" = mv ]; then set -- mv -T "$2" "$3"; fi
  for delay in 0 1 2 4 8 10 10 10; do
    [ "$delay" = 0 ] || sleep "$delay"
    if [ "$2" = -T ] && { [ -e "$4" ] || [ -L "$4" ]; }; then
      printf 'Cannot publish %s: %s already exists.\n' "$3" "$4" >&2; exit 1
    fi
    if output="$(LC_ALL=C "$@" 2>&1)"; then
      [ -z "$output" ] || printf '%s\n' "$output"
      exit 0
    else
      status=$?
    fi
    case "$output" in
      *'Permission denied'* | *'Device or resource busy'* | *'Access is denied'*) ;;
      *) printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; exit "$status" ;;
    esac
  done
  printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
  printf '%s\n' 'An antivirus/real-time scan may be locking the new goat.exe. Consider excluding %USERPROFILE%\.goat\runtime, then retry.' >&2
  exit "$status"
)
goat_runtime_publish() {
  # Another installer may have completed this version during extraction on Windows; keep it.
  case "$(uname -s)" in
    MINGW* | MSYS* | CYGWIN*)
      if [ -x "$2/goat" ] && [ "$(cat "$2/.install-complete" 2>/dev/null)" = "$3" ]; then
        rm -rf "$1" 2>/dev/null || :; return 0
      fi ;;
  esac
  goat_runtime_fs rm -rf "$2"
  goat_runtime_fs mv "$1" "$2"
}
prepend_path_if_dir() {

remote_node_satisfies_engine() {
  GOAT_NODE_ENGINE_RANGE=''
  if [ -z "$GOAT_NODE_ENGINE_RANGE" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  node - "$GOAT_NODE_ENGINE_RANGE" <<'NODE'
function satisfiesSemverRange(rawVersion, range) {
  const normalizedVersion = String(rawVersion).trim().replace(/^v/, "");
  const versionMatch = normalizedVersion.match(
    /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\.(\d+))?(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/,
  );
  if (!versionMatch) {
    return false;
  }

  const version = {
    major: Number(versionMatch[1]),
    minor: Number(versionMatch[2] || 0),
    patch: Number(versionMatch[3] || 0),
  };

  return range.split("||").some((group) => {
    const comparators = group.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (comparators.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }
    return comparators.every((comparator) => {
      const match = comparator.trim().match(/^(\^|>=|>|<=|<|=)?\s*v?(\d+(?:\.\d+){0,2})$/);
      if (!match) {
        return false;
      }
      const targetVersion = match[2];
      if (targetVersion === undefined) {
        return false;
      }
      const targetMatch = targetVersion.match(/^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\.(\d+))?$/);
      if (!targetMatch) {
        return false;
      }
      const target = {
        major: Number(targetMatch[1]),
        minor: Number(targetMatch[2] || 0),
        patch: Number(targetMatch[3] || 0),
      };
      const compared =
        version.major !== target.major
          ? version.major > target.major
            ? 1
            : -1
          : version.minor !== target.minor
            ? version.minor > target.minor
              ? 1
              : -1
            : version.patch !== target.patch
              ? version.patch > target.patch
                ? 1
                : -1
              : 0;
      const operator = match[1] || "=";
      switch (operator) {
        case "^":
          if (compared < 0) {
            return false;
          }
          if (target.major > 0) {
            return version.major === target.major;
          }
          if (target.minor > 0) {
            return version.major === 0 && version.minor === target.minor;
          }
          return version.major === 0 && version.minor === 0 && version.patch === target.patch;
        case ">=":
          return compared >= 0;
        case ">":
          return compared > 0;
        case "<=":
          return compared <= 0;
        case "<":
          return compared < 0;
        case "=":
          return compared === 0;
        default:
          return false;
      }
    });
  });
}
var range = process.argv[2] || "";
var rawVersion =
  process.versions && process.versions.node ? process.versions.node : process.version;
if (!satisfiesSemverRange(rawVersion, range)) {
  process.stderr.write(
    "Remote node " + rawVersion + " does not satisfy required range " + range + ".\n",
  );
  process.exit(1);
}
NODE
}

  goat_reclaim_lock() (

      printf 'Another GOAT %s installation has held %s for too long.\n' "$GOAT_ARCHIVE_VERSION" "$GOAT_LOCK" >&2

owned_identity_repairable() {

owned_identity_repairable_now() {

  [ "$LIVE_STATUS" = live ] && [ "$LIVE_OWNED" = 1 ] && valid_version "$LIVE_VERSION" || return 1
  [ -f "$STATE_DIR/identity" ] && [ ! -L "$STATE_DIR/identity" ] || return 1

  repair_identity="$repair_dir/goat serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port $LIVE_PORT --base-dir $DEFAULT_SERVER_HOME"
  server_snapshot "$LIVE_PID" || return 1
  repair_uid="$(server_uid "$LIVE_PID")" || return 1

  exec_fact_key "$report_exe" && [ "$FACT_KEY" = "$report_caps_key" ] &&
    [ "${report_runner% *}" = "${report_caps_key% *}" ] || return 0
  case "$FRAME_LIVE" in "ok "*) report_live="${FRAME_LIVE#ok }" ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
  case "$FRAME_COMPAT" in "ok "*) report_compat="${FRAME_COMPAT#ok }" ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
  fact_valid live "$report_live" && fact_valid compat "$report_compat" || return 0

# netstat answers in about 0.15 s where a PowerShell start takes 1.5 s, but its state word is
# localized on some display languages. It proves server $1 owns 127.0.0.1:$2 only after it exited
# 0 within 5 s and its whole output has exactly one row from 127.0.0.1:$2 to 0.0.0.0:0, and it is
# TCP 127.0.0.1:$2 0.0.0.0:0 LISTENING $1. Output that ends mid-line was cut short and proves nothing.
# Bash only. read -d '' takes the file whole and succeeds only at a NUL byte, which netstat never
# prints (a command substitution would drop it).
listener_netstat_owns() {
  if launch_bounded 5 netstat.exe -ano -p TCP </dev/null >"$STATE_DIR/netstat.$$" 2>/dev/null; then
    listener_status=0; else listener_status=1; fi

    case "$listener_netstat" in *"
"*) ;; *) [ -z "$listener_netstat" ] || return 1; break ;; esac
    listener_line="${listener_netstat%%"
"*}"
    listener_netstat="${listener_netstat#*"
"}"

# never sends to a dead process, so no reused PID is hit (bash loops forever on a pipeline job with
# a dead member). TERM, then KILL after up to 2 s of clock-checked waits; waited for only after.
end_job() {

launch_bounded_job() { MSYS2_ARG_CONV_EXCL='*' exec "$@"; }

# it was ended at the bound. It is checked at once and then after 0.05, 0.1 and every 0.25 s. Other
# hosts, and shells other than bash, whose job specs cannot name it safely, run it directly.
launch_bounded() {
  if [ "$GOAT_HOST_WINDOWS" != 1 ] || [ -z "${BASH_VERSION:-}" ]; then shift; "$@"; return; fi

      end_job '%?launch_bounded_job' "$launch_bound_job"; return 124
    fi

wait_launched_listener() {

    # checking it every 0.1 s: exit 0 once it does, 3 once the server is gone, 4 at the deadline.
    # A failed start (any other exit) is started again before the deadline.
    while launch_now && [ "$launch_now_us" -lt "$((listen_deadline * 1000000))" ]; do
      if GOAT_PROCESS_ID="$REMOTE_PID" GOAT_LISTEN_PORT="$REMOTE_PORT" GOAT_WAIT_UNTIL_MS="$listen_deadline"000 \
        launch_bounded $((listen_deadline - launch_now_us / 1000000)) powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand '' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1

        3) LISTEN_GONE="$REMOTE_PID"; return 2 ;;

# tasklist runs bounded to 5 s. Gone is only its localized "INFO: no tasks" answer: exit 0 and one

# checks in this script do not run tasklist again.
launch_server_alive() {

    launch_probe=0; else launch_probe=$?; fi

  launch_alive=0

# Rows are read with shell builtins, as the awk program they replace read them: ps's status is

# Key $2 counts when any line declares it, else key $3; quoted values only. Builtins only: an

hint_nl='

hint_end='# End of the declarations GOAT reads without running this runner.'

hint_take() {

  case "$1" in "$3='"*"'") hint_value="${1#"$3='"}"; hint_back="$hint_back${hint_value%"'"}$hint_nl" ;; esac

    case "$1" in "$4="*) hint_named2=1 ;; esac

# as $(...) would keep them, from every line of runner $1. bash reads the file in one call and,
# when no line after the end-of-declarations line starts with a key, parses only the lines
# before it, which give the same answer; other shells and files with NUL bytes read each line.
runner_hint_set() {

  if [ -n "$hint_named2" ]; then RUNNER_HINT2="$hint_want2"; else RUNNER_HINT2="$hint_back2"; fi

    { IFS= read -r caps_line && ! IFS= read -r caps_more && [ -z "$caps_more" ]; } <"$caps_tmp-out" || return 0
    caps_valid "$caps_line" || return 0
  elif [ "$caps_status" = 1 ] && [ "$caps_err" = "$helper_caps_old" ]; then
    caps_line="caps v1"
  else
    return 0
  fi
  HELPER_CAPS="${caps_line#caps v1}"; HELPER_CAPS="${HELPER_CAPS# }"
  if exec_fact_key "$1" && [ "$FACT_KEY" = "$caps_key" ]; then fact_put "$caps_name" "$caps_key" "$caps_line"; fi

# Appends answer $3 to question $1 under key $2 to this script's memo (see frame_memo_get).
frame_memo_put() {
  case "$1$2$3" in *"$fact_nl"*) return 0 ;; esac
  printf '\n%s\n%s\n%s\n\n\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" >>"$FACT_MEMO" 2>/dev/null || :

# True when live answer $1 names a live server on a port: then, and only then, the frame answers compat.
facts_frame_live_server() {

}
# Sets FRAME_<TAG> to each answer in the reply $3 of combined call $1 ("ok <tokens>" or
# "fail <word>"). Fails unless the whole frame is valid: its begin line, tags from $2 or compat
# each at most once, every tag in $2, compat exactly when live names a live server, and an end
# line that counts the answers with nothing after it. The capability line `facts --with-caps`
# prints may follow the begin line, well formed and uncounted; with $4 "caps" it must, listing facts.
frame_parse() {
  FRAME_MANIFEST=; FRAME_COMMIT=; FRAME_READY=; FRAME_LIVE=; FRAME_COMPAT=; FRAME_VERSION=; FRAME_OWN=
  frame_count=0
  case "$3" in "begin v1 $1$fact_nl"*) frame_rest="${3#*"$fact_nl"}" ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  frame_caps=
  case "$frame_rest" in "caps v1$fact_nl"*|"caps v1 "*)
    frame_caps="${frame_rest%%"$fact_nl"*}"; frame_rest="${frame_rest#*"$fact_nl"}"
    caps_valid "$frame_caps" || return 1 ;;
  esac
  if [ "${4:-}" = caps ]; then
    case " ${frame_caps#caps v1} " in *" facts "*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  fi
  while :; do
    case "$frame_rest" in *"$fact_nl"*) ;; *) break ;; esac
    frame_line="${frame_rest%%"$fact_nl"*}"; frame_rest="${frame_rest#*"$fact_nl"}"
    frame_tag="${frame_line%% *}"; frame_answer="${frame_line#* }"
    [ "$frame_line" = "$frame_tag $frame_answer" ] || return 1
    case " $2 compat " in *" $frame_tag "*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    case "$frame_answer" in "ok "?*|"fail error"|"fail timeout"|"fail changed"|"fail unavailable") ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
    case "$frame_tag" in
      manifest) [ -z "$FRAME_MANIFEST" ] || return 1; FRAME_MANIFEST="$frame_answer" ;;
      commit) [ -z "$FRAME_COMMIT" ] || return 1; FRAME_COMMIT="$frame_answer" ;;
      ready) [ -z "$FRAME_READY" ] || return 1; FRAME_READY="$frame_answer" ;;
      live) [ -z "$FRAME_LIVE" ] || return 1; FRAME_LIVE="$frame_answer" ;;
      compat) [ -z "$FRAME_COMPAT" ] || return 1; FRAME_COMPAT="$frame_answer" ;;
      version) [ -z "$FRAME_VERSION" ] || return 1; FRAME_VERSION="$frame_answer" ;;
      own) [ -z "$FRAME_OWN" ] || return 1; FRAME_OWN="$frame_answer" ;;
      *) return 1 ;;
    esac
    frame_count=$((frame_count + 1))
  done
  [ "$frame_rest" = "end $frame_count" ] || return 1
  for frame_tag in $2; do
    case "$frame_tag" in
      manifest) [ -n "$FRAME_MANIFEST" ] ;;
      commit) [ -n "$FRAME_COMMIT" ] ;;
      ready) [ -n "$FRAME_READY" ] ;;
      live) [ -n "$FRAME_LIVE" ] ;;
      version) [ -n "$FRAME_VERSION" ] ;;
      own) [ -n "$FRAME_OWN" ] ;;
      *) false ;;
    esac || return 1
  done
  if facts_frame_live_server "$FRAME_LIVE"; then [ -n "$FRAME_COMPAT" ]; else [ -z "$FRAME_COMPAT" ]; fi
}
# Runs goat $1 with arguments $2... and sets frame_out to its reply. Succeeds only for exit status
# 0 with nothing on stderr: reads stdout to a bound (1024 characters are at most 4096 bytes) as
# lines a NUL breaks and x ends, keeps one byte of stderr, and takes the status from a file only it
# writes.
frame_direct_call() {
  : >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status" || return 1
  frame_out="$({ { "$@" 2>&1 1>&3 3>&-
      printf '%s\n' "$?" >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status"; } | head -c 1 >"$FACT_MEMO.facts-err" 3>&-; } 3>&1 |
    head -c 4097 | tr '\000' '\n'; printf x)"
  IFS= read -r frame_status <"$FACT_MEMO.facts-status" && [ "$frame_status" = 0 ] &&
    [ ! -s "$FACT_MEMO.facts-err" ] && [ "${#frame_out}" -le 1025 ] || return 1
  case "$frame_out" in *"$fact_nl"x) frame_out="${frame_out%"$fact_nl"x}" ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
}

facts_frame_compat_valid() {
  set -f; set -- $1

  case "$1" in compatible|update-required|client-too-old|unknown) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$2" in 0|1) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  case "$3" in ''|-|*[!$token_chars]*) return 1 ;; esac
}

# Declared contract extension: for the client's own runtime version reached through the candidate
# runner this launch just wrote and pinned, facts --version, --own and --live answer as --version,
# protocol --shell and protocol --runtime-file ... --shell do (the same functions in apps/server,
# pinned by its contract test). So one start asks the questions not yet answered, when two or
# more are missing, and its answers are recorded under the rules of the calls they stand for:
# version and own under the pin's exec key, which holds its digest, so a young pin rewritten within
# its second misses; live only as live_fact would keep it, bound to a live key that held across the
# call or, for no server, in this script's memo, which live_fact reads only while all three files
# stay absent. Any other runner, a changed exec key or live input, or any invalid answer records
# nothing, leaves no marker, and the separate calls run as before.
launch_want() { launch_asks="$launch_asks --$1"; launch_tags="$launch_tags $1"; launch_count=$((launch_count + 1)); }
launch_facts_ask() {

    [ -n "$FACT_MEMO" ] || return 0
  launch_pin="$RUNNER_CANDIDATE_FILE.pin"

  [ -z "$RUNNER_NODE_DECLARED" ] && [ "$RUNNER_ARCHIVE_VERSION" = "$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION" ] || return 0
  exec_fact_key "$launch_pin" && [ "$FACT_NAME" = "$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION.runner" ] || return 0
  launch_name="$FACT_NAME"; launch_key="$FACT_KEY"; launch_exec="$FACT_NAME $FACT_KEY"
  launch_asks=; launch_tags=; launch_count=0; launch_absent=; launch_live=
  fact_get "version.$launch_name" "$launch_key" >/dev/null || launch_want version
  fact_get "own.$launch_name" "$launch_key" >/dev/null || launch_want own
  # One missing question at most: its separate call costs what the frame would, without the live key.
  [ "$launch_count" -ge 1 ] || return 0
  if live_none_absent "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE"; then
    launch_absent=1
    live_none_get "$launch_exec" >/dev/null || launch_want live
  elif live_fact_key "$launch_pin" "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE"; then
    launch_live="$FACT_KEY"
    fact_get "live.$launch_name" "$launch_live" >/dev/null || launch_want live
  fi
  [ "$launch_count" -ge 2 ] || return 0
  frame_direct_call "$launch_pin" __ssh-helper facts --with-caps $launch_asks --runtime-file "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" --port-file "$PORT_FILE" --pid-file "$PID_FILE" || return 0
  exec_fact_key "$launch_pin" && [ "$FACT_NAME $FACT_KEY" = "$launch_exec" ] || return 0
  launch_held=
  if [ -n "$launch_absent" ]; then
    ! live_none_absent "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE" || launch_held=absent
  elif [ -n "$launch_live" ] && live_fact_key "$launch_pin" "$DEFAULT_RUNTIME_FILE" "$PORT_FILE" "$PID_FILE" &&
       [ "$FACT_KEY" = "$launch_live" ]; then
    launch_held=live
  fi
  case " $launch_tags " in *" live "*) [ -n "$launch_held" ] || return 0 ;; esac
  frame_parse facts "$launch_tags" "$frame_out" caps || return 0
  case " $launch_tags " in *" version "*) [ "$FRAME_VERSION" = "ok goat v$OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION" ] || return 0 ;; esac
  case " $launch_tags " in *" own "*)
    case "$FRAME_OWN" in "ok $OWN_RUNTIME_VERSION "*) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
    (set -f; set -- ${FRAME_OWN#ok }; valid_own_tokens "$@") || return 0 ;;
  esac
  case " $launch_tags " in *" live "*)
    case "$FRAME_LIVE" in "ok "*) ;; *) return 0 ;; esac
    (set -f; set -- ${FRAME_LIVE#ok }; valid_live_tokens "$@") || return 0 ;;
  esac
  [ -z "$FRAME_VERSION" ] || fact_put "version.$launch_name" "$launch_key" "${FRAME_VERSION#ok }"
  [ -z "$FRAME_OWN" ] || fact_put "own.$launch_name" "$launch_key" "${FRAME_OWN#ok }"
  case "$launch_held $FRAME_LIVE" in
    "absent ok none unknown unknown unknown 0 0") frame_memo_put live-none "$launch_exec" "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }" ;;
    "live ok live "*)
      facts_frame_live_ids "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }"
      if fact_valid live "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }" && fact_bound "$frame_pid" "$frame_port"; then
        fact_put "live.$launch_name" "$launch_live" "${FRAME_LIVE#ok }"
      fi ;;

}

release_recovery_lock() {

owner_proven_dead() {

     [ "$(readlink "$RECOVERY" 2>/dev/null || true)" != "$OWNER" ]; then

  release_recovery_lock

  for delay in 0 1 2 4 8 10 10 10; do
    [ "$delay" = 0 ] || sleep "$delay"
    if [ "$2" = -T ] && { [ -e "$4" ] || [ -L "$4" ]; }; then
      printf 'Cannot publish %s: %s already exists.\n' "$3" "$4" >&2; exit 1
    fi
    if output="$(LC_ALL=C "$@" 2>&1)"; then
      [ -z "$output" ] || printf '%s\n' "$output"
      exit 0
    else
      status=$?
    fi
    case "$output" in
      *'Permission denied'* | *'Device or resource busy'* | *'Access is denied'*) ;;
      *) printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2; exit "$status" ;;
    esac
  done
  printf '%s\n' "$output" >&2
  printf '%s\n' 'An antivirus/real-time scan may be locking the new goat.exe. Consider excluding %USERPROFILE%\.goat\runtime, then retry.' >&2

remote_node_satisfies_engine() {
  GOAT_NODE_ENGINE_RANGE=''
  if [ -z "$GOAT_NODE_ENGINE_RANGE" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  node - "$GOAT_NODE_ENGINE_RANGE" <<'NODE'
function satisfiesSemverRange(rawVersion, range) {
  const normalizedVersion = String(rawVersion).trim().replace(/^v/, "");
  const versionMatch = normalizedVersion.match(
    /^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\.(\d+))?(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?$/,
  );
  if (!versionMatch) {
    return false;
  }

  const version = {
    major: Number(versionMatch[1]),
    minor: Number(versionMatch[2] || 0),
    patch: Number(versionMatch[3] || 0),
  };

  return range.split("||").some((group) => {
    const comparators = group.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    if (comparators.length === 0) {
      return false;
    }
    return comparators.every((comparator) => {
      const match = comparator.trim().match(/^(\^|>=|>|<=|<|=)?\s*v?(\d+(?:\.\d+){0,2})$/);
      if (!match) {
        return false;
      }
      const targetVersion = match[2];
      if (targetVersion === undefined) {
        return false;
      }
      const targetMatch = targetVersion.match(/^(\d+)(?:\.(\d+))?(?:\.(\d+))?$/);
      if (!targetMatch) {
        return false;
      }
      const target = {
        major: Number(targetMatch[1]),
        minor: Number(targetMatch[2] || 0),
        patch: Number(targetMatch[3] || 0),
      };
      const compared =
        version.major !== target.major
          ? version.major > target.major
            ? 1
            : -1
          : version.minor !== target.minor
            ? version.minor > target.minor
              ? 1
              : -1
            : version.patch !== target.patch
              ? version.patch > target.patch
                ? 1
                : -1
              : 0;
      const operator = match[1] || "=";
      switch (operator) {
        case "^":
          if (compared < 0) {
            return false;
          }
          if (target.major > 0) {
            return version.major === target.major;
          }
          if (target.minor > 0) {
            return version.major === 0 && version.minor === target.minor;
          }
          return version.major === 0 && version.minor === 0 && version.patch === target.patch;
        case ">=":
          return compared >= 0;
        case ">":
          return compared > 0;
        case "<=":
          return compared <= 0;
        case "<":
          return compared < 0;
        case "=":
          return compared === 0;
        default:
          return false;
      }
    });
  });
}
var range = process.argv[2] || "";
var rawVersion =
  process.versions && process.versions.node ? process.versions.node : process.version;
if (!satisfiesSemverRange(rawVersion, range)) {
  process.stderr.write(
    "Remote node " + rawVersion + " does not satisfy required range " + range + ".\n",
  );
  process.exit(1);
}
NODE
}

ensure_remote_node_path() {
  if command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && remote_node_satisfies_engine >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    return 0

  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.local/bin"
  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/bin"

  # before these lines, so the launch script also prepends them unconditionally.
  prepend_path_if_dir "/usr/sbin"
  prepend_path_if_dir "/sbin"

  if [ -z "${VOLTA_HOME:-}" ]; then
    VOLTA_HOME="$HOME/.volta"
  fi
  export VOLTA_HOME
  prepend_path_if_dir "$VOLTA_HOME/bin"

  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.asdf/shims"
  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.asdf/bin"
  if [ ! -x "$HOME/.asdf/shims/node" ] && [ -s "$HOME/.asdf/asdf.sh" ]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1090

  fi

  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.mise/shims"
  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    eval "$(mise activate sh)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

  if [ -z "${FNM_DIR:-}" ]; then

  export FNM_DIR
  prepend_path_if_dir "$FNM_DIR"
  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.fnm"

    eval "$(fnm env --shell bash)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.nodenv/bin"
  prepend_path_if_dir "$HOME/.nodenv/shims"
  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v nodenv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    eval "$(nodenv init -)" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi

  if [ -z "${NVM_DIR:-}" ]; then
    NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"
  fi
  export NVM_DIR

  if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then
    # shellcheck disable=SC1090
    . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
    if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && command -v nvm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      nvm use --silent default >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use --silent node >/dev/null 2>&1 || nvm use --silent --lts >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
  fi

  if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -d "$NVM_DIR/versions/node" ]; then
    for GOAT_NODE_BIN in "$NVM_DIR"/versions/node/*/bin; do
      if [ -x "$GOAT_NODE_BIN/node" ]; then
        PATH="$GOAT_NODE_BIN:$PATH"
        export PATH
      fi
    done
  fi

  command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && remote_node_satisfies_engine

adopt_managed_orphan() {

# process is exactly the archive serve this host installed, run by this user, the canonical
# identity replaces it (the old file is kept as identity.unverified); anything else stays refused.
owned_identity_repairable() {
  if owned_identity_repairable_now; then repair_check=0; else repair_check=1; fi

owned_identity_repairable_now() {
  [ "${OWNING_LAUNCH:-0}" = 1 ] && [ "${LEGACY_PENDING:-0}" != 1 ] || return 1
  [ "$LIVE_STATUS" = live ] && [ "$LIVE_OWNED" = 1 ] && valid_version "$LIVE_VERSION" || return 1
  [ -f "$STATE_DIR/identity" ] && [ ! -L "$STATE_DIR/identity" ] || return 1
  repair_dir="$HOME/.goat/runtime/goat/versions/$LIVE_VERSION"

    [ "$(cat "$repair_dir/.install-complete" 2>/dev/null)" = "$LIVE_VERSION" ] || return 1
  repair_identity="$repair_dir/goat serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port $LIVE_PORT --base-dir $DEFAULT_SERVER_HOME"
  server_snapshot "$LIVE_PID" || return 1
  repair_uid="$(server_uid "$LIVE_PID")" || return 1

' "$repair_uid" | awk 'NF==1 { print $1 }')" = "$(id -u)" ] || return 1

repair_owned_identity() {
  owned_identity_repairable || return 1
